summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the new Account Sync (Emergent Google sign-in) feature. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_api.py to seed users/sessions directly in Mongo and send Authorization: Bearer headers. 21/21 pytest tests PASSED including auth gating (401 on bogus session_id, no token, invalid token, expired session), /auth/me, cross-user isolation (404 on other user's quote GET/PATCH/DELETE), soft delete, logout invalidation, and a static device-merge filter check mirroring server.py update_many. Frontend (390x844) verified: unauth root/editor/(tabs) all redirect to /login showing login-screen + login-google-button; clicking the Google button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/. Injecting the seeded session token into localStorage key qc.session_token (JSON-serialized) before load successfully boots the app into the authenticated Capture tab; Settings shows settings-account-card with the seeded name/email and settings-sign-out-button; History lists the seeded quote; Sign out returns to /login. No deprecated expo packages or React Native issues detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup' / 'shutdown') — consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, cosmetic).
api.ts: 401 handler is suppressed for /auth/* paths; this is correct and intentional so that /auth/me on expired tokens doesn't trigger onUnauthorized before boot restore completes.
server.py get_current_user handles both naive and tz-aware expires_at; the TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at will auto-purge, which is good.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed TEST_user_a / TEST_user_b with tokens TOKEN_A/TOKEN_B and an expired-session token at module setup, and clean them up on teardown. UI test seeded TEST_ui_user + session TEST_ui_token_abc + one quote in Mongo; cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use pytest -o addopts='' to disable the default -n auto in /app/backend/pytest.ini — the module-scoped seed fixture races and causes duplicate-key errors under xdist. All /api/quotes* and /api/auth/me|logout endpoints require a Bearer session token seeded in db.user_sessions (test_credentials.md documents the shape). For UI auth bypass: `localStorage.setItem('qc.session_token', JSON.stringify('<token>'))` via page.add_init_script works because the AsyncStorage web shim persists to localStorage with JSON-serialized values. Real Google sign-in cannot be automated; device-merge is covered by a Mongo-level static check that reproduces the server.py update_many filter.
